Author: Raj Beer Singh
Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 77
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 12453 of 2023
Applicant :- Bal Kishan

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Santosh Kumar Shukla Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Noor Muhammad,Saumya Srivastava,Yogesh Kumar Srivasta Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present bail application has been filed by the applicant in Case Crime No. 252 of 2022, under Sections 363, 366, 376 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Narkhi, District Firozabad,
with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that applicant is innocent and he has not committed any offence.

The first information report was lodged on 26.05.2022, alleging that on 25.05.2022 daughter of the informant has gone missing and she has also taken away Rs. 50,000/-
cash and some jewelries from the house.

In her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., victim girl has stated that her age is 19 years and that on the night of 24.05.2022 she along with applicant went to Etah and from there they went to Punjab and they have married with each other in a temple and Bal Kishan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135942013/
1 physical relations were established between them.

sentences.text: It was pointed out that in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., victim has stated that her parents were scolding her and thus, she herself has left her home in anger and went to home of her maternal uncle and that on 30.05.2022, she returned back to home.
In her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she has not stated that she was taken away by applicant or any relations were established between them.
Victim has not even named the applicant in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
As per school record as well as medical report, age of victim is about 17 years.

Lastly, it is submitted that applicant is languishing in jail since 22.01.2023, having no criminal history, and that in case he is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant have opposed the bail application and argued that age of victim is about 17 years.

Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

Let the applicant Bal Kishan, involved in aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:
1. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during the trial.
2. The applicant shall not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witness.
3. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
4. The applicant shall not commit an offence similar to the offence of which he is accused, or suspected, of the commission of which he is suspected.

5. The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade them from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
In case of breach of any of the above condition, the Court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel bail of applicant in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 21.4.2023 Suraj  Bal Kishan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135942013/
